# A non-git base at a repository root excludes only its own directories there,
# so a second, embedded base in a subdirectory keeps committing — in either
# creation order.

env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=user.name
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=ambient
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=user.email
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1=ambient@local

# Root first: the unversioned base at the repository root is excluded by its
# own directories, and the embedded base created afterwards still initializes
# and commits through the host repository.
mkdir host
cd host
exec git init -q

exec akb init . --no-git --force
stdout '^Initialized KB "host" at .*/host$'
stdout '^kb: excluded /\.agent-kb/, /kb/, /raw/ from host git tracking via \.git/info/exclude \(local to this clone; remove those lines to undo\)$'
! stdout 'commit identity'

exec akb init sub --embed
stdout '^Initialized KB "sub" at .*/host/sub$'
stdout '^kb: sub is embedded inside repository .*; akb commits only kb/, raw/, \.agent-kb/$'
stdout '^commit identity: from git config \(ambient <ambient@local>\) — not recorded; each machine''s git identity applies$'

cd sub
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/note.yaml
stdin ../../note-input.md
exec akb write notes/root-first.md
stdout '^Written to kb/notes/root-first\.md$'
! stderr 'ignored by one of your'
cd ..
exec git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^akb: write kb/notes/root-first\.md$'

# Embedded first: the non-git base created at the root afterwards must not
# take over the embedded base's directories, which keep committing.
cd $WORK
mkdir host2
cd host2
exec git init -q

exec akb init sub --embed
stdout '^Initialized KB "sub" at .*/host2/sub$'
stdout '^commit identity: from git config \(ambient <ambient@local>\) — not recorded; each machine''s git identity applies$'

cd sub
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/note.yaml
cd ..

exec akb init . --no-git --force
stdout '^Initialized KB "host2" at .*/host2$'
stdout '^kb: excluded /\.agent-kb/, /kb/, /raw/ from host git tracking via \.git/info/exclude \(local to this clone; remove those lines to undo\)$'

cd sub
stdin ../../note-input.md
exec akb write notes/embed-first.md
stdout '^Written to kb/notes/embed-first\.md$'
! stderr 'ignored by one of your'
cd ..
exec git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^akb: write kb/notes/embed-first\.md$'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Coexisting note
summary: Note in a base that sits beside a non-git base
tags: versioning
---
A page written in an embedded base beside a non-git base at the repository root.
